name: ChartMogul
description: ChartMogul's hosted server reads MRR, churn and customer subscription data.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (mcp.chartmogul.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
